gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-major-mono-dis: Major Mono Display glows like neon tubing, every letter spaced far from its neighbor. Pramukh Rounded sits against that monospace body with tightly bunched, friendly forms, so a long stretch of text moves in a slow, deliberate, almost technical stride.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-marcellus-sc: Marcellus SC has the stately stature of cast iron capitals, with a mild shading that lends it a literary hush. Red Hat Display is best at bold, marker-like statements with open curves, and the classic serif is best at dignified, quietly modulated lines.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-scope-one: Bold and contemporary, Red Hat Display draws a marker line with daylight inside every curve. Scope One follows with stubby ascenders, a big x-height and spilling counters, giving the classic serif a traditional, refined footing under that confident heading.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-slabo-13px: Marker-bold and sunlit. Red Hat Display holds one width through every curve, while Slabo 13px, a bookish serif with tall open counters, sits underneath and gives the page a dignified, grounded rhythm.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-ibm-plex-sans-th: IBM Plex Sans Thai Looped has curves that refuse to close. Balsamiq Sans brings a bold, stencil-like weight with no pinched bends, and next to the clean sans it feels expressive, loose and friendly.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-noto-sans-canadi: Noto Sans Canadian Aboriginal keeps every curve end open and contemporary. Noto Sans Canadian Aboriginal, a plain sans, is the quiet half, so Balsamiq Sans and its bold, round, unswelling outlines get all the personality.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-istok-web: Commanding, distinctive shapes from Bellota Text, with open curves and a monoweight stroke that never shades. Istok Web, a modern sans with approachable rounded letters, keeps a long passage flowing smoothly.
